issues.what: Final runway block (00:32-00:36): the racetrack cars are Pixar-Cars-style characters with eyes on the windshield, and the yellow and blue cars carry AI-drawn race numbers (looks like 95 / 55). The cars also swerve, spark and crash under the landing airliner's nose gear (00:35-00:36), which is not in the script. AI-drawn text plus lookalike character IP.
issues.fix: Regenerate the block-5 runway shot (shot 1) with 'plain generic race cars, no numbers, no logos, no faces, parked or driving well clear of the runway', or swap that 2-3 s span for a plain runway shot.

issues.what: Pearson waving at 00:39-00:40: profile face distorted (huge nose, one eye lost, head cropped at frame edge), upper arm and raised hand elongated; passengers leave by orange stairs, not the slide the script describes. At 00:41-00:42 he grins with mouth wide open exactly while the narrator says 'Gimli Glider' (reads as talking).
issues.fix: Regenerate shot 2 of the last block (close-up smile, mouth closed, passengers on the slide) or trim the span at 00:39-00:40.

issues.what: Fuel counter reads 98% -> 79% -> 61% -> 45% FUEL, counting DOWN while the truck is supposedly loading fuel (00:16-00:20). It contradicts the picture; the 98% start also implies a nearly full tank. The hose hangs loose beside the truck. The same truck picture holds about 5 s (00:16-00:21).
issues.fix: Re-render with the counter counting up 0% -> 45% (or relabel it 'FUEL LOADED: 45% OF NEEDED'); shorten the truck shot.

issues.what: Quintal (00:21-00:23) switches to a flat 2D cel look, unlike the 3D Pixar-style Quintal at 00:08-00:10 and the rest of the film. He also smiles calmly while tapping the screen as the engines die.
issues.fix: Regenerate the Quintal cockpit shot with the cast reference so the style matches, with a worried expression.

issues.what: Brass balance scale (00:13-00:15) falls apart: both pans buckle, flip and fold like foil, which is object melt and morph, not a scale tipping.
issues.fix: Regenerate the scale shot with a simple tilt (heavy pan drops, light pan rises), or cut at 00:12.

issues.what: Hook title (00:00-00:02.6) sits across Pearson's eyes and brow; readable but covers the key expression. Aircraft shown is a narrow-body Airbus-style twin-jet with wrong tail, not the Boeing 767 widebody (00:02-00:04, 00:27-00:36). Pearson's sleeve shows 3 stripes in places, script says 4. Hook words 'At forty-one thousand feet, both' carry the stake only on the second clause.
issues.fix: Optional: move the hook title lower or higher; accept the rest.

issues.what: Voice matches the script word for word (whisper 'At 41,000 feet' = 'forty-one thousand feet'). Captions match the voice. No silence, black or frozen stretch over 1 s. Captions file and publish plan carry the AI disclosure. Facts match the Wikipedia source (22,300 lb vs kg, 17 min, 69 aboard, Gimli racetrack).
